newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian shrs seen easing on holidays, technicals.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian shrs seen easing on holidays, technicals.

text.p: 0740 GMT - The Hungarian share market is expected to enter a phase of downward correction, traders said.
* One trader expected corrections to come as the summer season starts, while another said a correction was imminent on technical grounds.
* Traders said interest in September BUX futures is low therefore some investors may decide to close positions by selling on the cash market.
* Traders said the market's longer-term outlook was positive as Hungary's international reputation is good.
* On Monday the BUX index finished at a record closing high of 6,795 points, up 10.34.
